Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from this section's selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge or memory.
The hydroplaning steps on the first selected page continue a list introduced on the previous page; they are taught from the page where they are printed [A01].
The snow and ice paragraph states the added stopping distance in seconds rather than in feet; it is taught as the manual words it, with no conversion [A01].
The wrong-way driver page names specific Arizona highways as examples of divided highways; the names are not taught as a complete list (verify AZ-NIGHT-D-ROUTES) [A03].
The wrong-way tips sit under a heading about driving at night, but the first tip says the advice applies at any time of day; it is taught that way [A03].
Originality: every statement is reworded from the cited page; no manual sentence, table, image or official test question is reproduced.
Exam numbers: the manual prints no question count, passing score, item format or time limit, so none is stated anywhere in this section; the typed debts live in part A.
External review: restating published Arizona traffic and licensing rules needs no clinical or legal sign-off; none is requested.
